About the St. Albert service area

Draft copy — pending the owner's review; wording and distances are approximate.

St. Albert sits on Edmonton's northwest edge, along the Sturgeon River, and it has the housing stock to prove its age: mature streets with original trim, dated colour schemes and woodwork that rewards a careful repaint. Chris Lloyd Ltd works across the city — from downtown-adjacent neighbourhoods to the newer subdivisions off Ray Gibbon Drive.

The work is mostly interiors: repainting walls, ceilings and trim in homes that were last painted decades ago, plus the odd exterior refresh ahead of an Alberta winter. If you're in St. Albert and want a straight answer about what your project needs, get in touch.

Where we're coming from: the shop is at 10412 66 Ave NW in west Edmonton; St. Albert is on Edmonton's northwest edge, a short drive up St. Albert Trail from downtown.

Painting & renovation services in St. Albert

The same interior, exterior and renovation work the main site describes, phrased for St. Albert homes.

Interior Painting

St. Albert interior painting: walls, ceilings, trim and woodwork, with tidy prep and clean lines. Furniture and floors are masked and protected; dust is minimised rather than swept under the drop sheet.

Exterior Painting

St. Albert exterior work: fascias, soffits, doors, garage siding and masonry accents, prepped and coated to hold up to an Alberta winter. Repairs and rot checks are flagged before the first brush stroke.

Renovation & Touch-Ups

St. Albert renovation support: drywall repair and painting, small refreshes, and finishing touch-ups around the rest of the job. Handover-ready rather than almost-finished.
